name: LangGraph Agentic RAG + Qdrant + Ragas
note: Every task runs a real command. The starter's Qdrant layer is its own in-memory store and no LLM is wired in, so no Qdrant server or model is needed. Tenant isolation is therefore verified against that in-memory store, not against a live Qdrant payload filter. The LangGraph graph is real (langgraph). The groundedness scorer is a lexical-overlap heuristic, not Ragas. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost from the kit files.

eval_tasks.title: Tenant isolation across the agentic cycle
eval_tasks.instruction: Retrieval must be partitioned per tenant on every pass of the rewrite loop, tenant must be mandatory with a restricted format, and Qdrant must not be published to the host.
assertions: tenant A never retrieves tenant B documents through the HTTP query path
rewrite cycles stay inside the tenant and find nothing across it
the same document id in two tenants does not collide
search, index, run and the HTTP schemas all reject a missing tenant
tenant ids with spaces, quotes, traversal or newlines are rejected
the qdrant compose service publishes no ports
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "tenant or cross or published or collide" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Cycle and recursion limits
eval_tasks.instruction: The rewrite loop must be bounded by a hard ceiling that no caller can lift, LangGraph must receive an explicit recursion limit, and a recursion error must stop the run.
assertions: max_iterations is clamped to a ceiling of 5, including hostile values
the HTTP schema rejects iteration counts outside 1..5
a query that matches nothing still terminates at the ceiling
routers stop rewriting once the budget is spent
LangGraph is invoked with an explicit recursion_limit
GraphRecursionError ends the run instead of falling back to a re-run
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "iteration or recursion or rewrite_loop or routers or compiled_graph" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Groundedness gate and prompt-injection boundary
eval_tasks.instruction: An answer still below the groundedness threshold after the rewrite budget must be withheld, the threshold must be configurable and clamped, and retrieved chunks must be delimited untrusted data.
assertions: the threshold defaults to 0.85, ignores garbage and clamps to [0, 1]
an ungrounded answer is replaced by a refusal and a grounded one is returned
the eval endpoint flags a hallucination and honours the configured threshold
each chunk sits in its own delimited block and cannot close it
document ids cannot inject markup into the block header
the graph state carries the delimited prompt
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "groundedness or ungrounded or grounded or eval_endpoint or prompt or block or markup" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: CORS, input limits, error hygiene, health and container hardening
eval_tasks.instruction: A wildcard CORS origin must never be honoured, bodies must be size-bounded, errors must not leak internals, health must reflect real state, and the image must run non-root.
assertions: a wildcard origin is dropped and unlisted origins get no allow header
oversized or malformed bodies are rejected with 422
graph failures return a generic 500
health is degraded when the vector store or the compiled graph is unavailable
the final Dockerfile stage drops to a numeric UID >= 10000
credential-named keys in .env.example are empty
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests -k "cors or oversized or generic_500 or health or non_root or env_example" -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite must pass with no failures.
assertions: pytest exits 0 across tests/
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
